I have written Cypher in 1 public repository, from 2024 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1).

Most recently: [kuzu-ex](@/work/kuzu-ex.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Cypher: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Cypher to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
